name: Quick Claw
effect: Held: Holder has a 3/16 (18.75%) chance to move first.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This light, sharp claw lets the bearer move first occasionally.

name: Silk Scarf
locations: Prize Exchange Center — 1000 coins / Central City
effect: Held: Normal-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.

name: Wide Lens
locations: Prize Exchange Center — 1000 coins / Central City
effect: Held: Provides a 1/10 (10%) boost in accuracy to the holder.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a magnifying lens that slightly boosts the accuracy of moves.

name: Zoom Lens
locations: Prize Exchange Center — 1000 coins / Central City
effect: Held: Provides a 1/5 (20%) boost in accuracy if the holder moves after the target.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder moves after its target moves, its accuracy will be boosted.

name: Metronome
locations: Prize Exchange Center — 1000 coins / Central City
effect: Held: Consectutive uses of the same attack have a cumulative damage boost of 10%. Maximum 100% boost.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts moves used consecutively but only until a different move is used.

name: Repel
effect: For 100 steps, prevents wild encounters of level lower than your party’s lead Pokémon.
flavor: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while.

name: Silver Powder
effect: Held: Bug-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a shiny silver powder that will boost the power of Bug-type moves.

name: Max Repel
effect: For 250 steps, prevents wild encounters of level lower than your party’s lead Pokémon.
flavor: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while. It lasts longer than Super Repel.

name: Stardust
effect: Sell for 1000 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 2000 Pokédollars.
flavor: Lovely red sand that flows between the fingers with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a low price to shops.

name: Exp. Share
effect: Held: Half the experience from a battle is split between Pokémon holding this item.
flavor: Turning on this special device will allow all the Pokémon on your team to receive Exp. Points from battles.

name: Lucky Egg
effect: Held: Increases EXP earned in battle by 50%.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s an egg filled with happiness that earns the holder extra Exp. Points in battle.

name: Leaf Stone
effect: Evolves an Exeggcute into Exeggutor, a Gloom into Vileplume, a Nuzleaf into Shiftry, a Pansage into Simisage, or a Weepinbell into Victreebel.
flavor: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable leaf pattern.

name: Charcoal
effect: Held: Fire-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a combustible fuel that boosts the power of Fire-type moves.

name: Nugget
effect: Sell for 5000 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 10000 Pokédollars.
flavor: A nugget of the purest gold that gives off a lustrous gleam in direct light. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

name: Leftovers
effect: Held: Restores 1/16 (6.25%) holder’s max HP at the end of each turn.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder’s HP is slowly but steadily restored throughout every battle.

name: Deep Sea Scale
effect: Doubles Clamperl’s Special Defense. Traded on a Clamperl: Holder evolves into Gorebyss.
flavor: An item to be held by Clamperl. This scale shines with a faint pink and raises the holder’s Sp. Def stat.

name: Soothe Bell
effect: Held: Doubles the happiness earned by the holder.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The comforting chime of this bell calms the holder, making it friendly.

name: Red Shard
effect: No effect. Can be traded for items or moves.
flavor: A small red shard. It appears to be a fragment of some sort of implement made long ago.

name: Dragon Scale
effect: Traded on a Seadra: Holder evolves into Kingdra.
flavor: A very tough and inflexible scale. Dragon-type Pokémon may be holding this item when caught.

name: Icy Rock
effect: Held: Hail by the holder lasts 8 rounds instead of 5.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Hail when used by the holder.

name: Hard Stone
effect: Held: Rock-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a durable stone that boosts the power of Rock-type moves.

name: Deep Sea Tooth
effect: Doubles Clamperl’s Special Attack. Traded on a Clamperl: Holder evolves into Huntail.
flavor: An item to be held by Clamperl. This fang gleams a sharp silver and raises the holder’s Sp. Atk stat.

name: Super Repel
effect: For 200 steps, prevents wild encounters of level lower than your party’s lead Pokémon.
flavor: An item that prevents any low-level wild Pokémon from jumping out at you for a while. It lasts longer than Repel.

name: Shiny Stone
effect: Evolves a Minccino into Cinccino, a Roselia into Roserade, or a Togetic into Togekiss.
flavor: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.

name: Fire Stone
effect: Evolves an Eevee into Flareon, a Growlithe into Arcanine, a Pansear into Simisear, or a Vulpix into Ninetales.
flavor: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. The stone has a fiery orange heart.

name: Moon Stone
locations: Old Man on a bench / Darkdusk City
effect: Evolves a Clefairy into Clefable, a Jigglypuff into Wigglytuff, a Munna into Musharna, a Nidorina into Nidoqueen, a Nidorino into Nidoking, or a Skitty into Delcatty.
flavor: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as the night sky.

name: Wave Incense
locations: Spirit Medium at Shadow Tower / Darkdusk City
effect: Held: Water-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Breeding: Mantine begets a Mantyke Egg.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This incense has a curious aroma that boosts the power of Water-type moves.

name: Razor Fang
effect: Held: Damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make their target flinch. Held by a Gligar while levelling up: Holder evolves into Gliscor.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.

name: Toxic Orb
effect: Held: Inflicts Toxic on the holder at the end of the turn. Activates after Poison damage would occur.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a bizarre orb that will badly poison the holder during battle.

name: Escape Rope
effect: Transports user to the outside entrance of a cave.
flavor: A long and durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from locations like caves or dungeons. It can be used any number of times.

name: Thick Club
effect: Doubles Cubone or Marowak’s Attack.
flavor: An item to be held by Cubone or Marowak. It’s a hard bone of some sort that boosts the Attack stat.

name: King's Rock
effect: Held: Damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make their target flinch. Traded on a Poliwhirl: Holder evolves into Politoed. Traded on a Slowpoke: Holder evolves into Slowking.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.

name: Water Stone
effect: Evolves an Eevee into Vaporeon, a Lombre into Ludicolo, a Panpour into Simipour, a Poliwhirl into Poliwrath, a Shellder into Cloyster, or a Staryu into Starmie.
flavor: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is the blue of a pool of clear water.

name: Big Pearl
effect: Sell for 3750 Pokédollars, or to Ore Collector for 7500 Pokédollars.
flavor: A rather large pearl that has a very nice silvery sheen. It can be sold at a high price to shops.

name: Electirizer
effect: Traded on an Electabuzz: Holder evolves into Electivire.
flavor: A box packed with a tremendous amount of electric energy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Potion
effect: Restores 20 HP.
flavor: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 20 HP to a single Pokémon.

name: Antidote
effect: Cures poison.
flavor: A spray-type medicine for treating poisoning. It can be used to lift the effects of being poisoned from a single Pokémon.

name: Ether
effect: Restores 10 PP for one move.
flavor: This medicine can be used to restore 10 PP to a single selected move that has been learned by a Pokémon.

name: Super Potion
effect: Restores 50 HP.
flavor: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 60 HP to a single Pokémon.

name: Revive
effect: Revives with half HP.
flavor: A medicine that can be used to revive a single Pokémon that has fainted. It also restores half of the Pokémon’s max HP.

name: Full Heal
effect: Cures any status ailment and confusion.
flavor: A spray-type medicine that is broadly effective. It can be used to heal all the status conditions of a single Pokémon.

name: Big Root
effect: Held: Increases HP recovered from draining moves, Ingrain, and Aqua Ring by 3/10 (30%).
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the amount of HP the holder restores from HP-stealing moves.

name: Carbos
effect: Raises Speed effort and happiness.
flavor: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Speed base points of a single Pokémon.

name: Elixir
effect: Restores 10 PP for each move.
flavor: This medicine can be used to restore 10 PP to each of the moves that have been learned by a Pokémon.

name: HP Up
effect: Raises HP effort and happiness.
flavor: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the HP base points of a single Pokémon.

name: Max Revive
effect: Revives with full HP.
flavor: A medicine that can be used to revive a single Pokémon that has fainted. It also fully restores the Pokémon’s max HP.

name: Protein
effect: Raises Attack effort and happiness.
flavor: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Attack base points of a single Pokémon.

name: Awakening
effect: Cures sleep.
flavor: A spray-type medicine to wake the sleeping. It can be used to rouse a single Pokémon from the clutches of sleep.

name: Max Ether
effect: Restores PP to full for one move.
flavor: This medicine can be used to fully restore the PP of a single selected move that has been learned by a Pokémon.

name: Calcium
effect: Raises Special Attack effort and happiness.
flavor: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Sp. Atk base points of a single Pokémon.

name: Hyper Potion
effect: Restores 200 HP.
flavor: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to restore 120 HP to a single Pokémon.

name: Paralyze Heal
effect: Cures paralysis.
flavor: A spray-type medicine for treating paralysis. It can be used to free a single Pokémon that has been paralyzed.

name: Max Potion
effect: Restores HP to full.
flavor: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. It can be used to completely restore the max HP of a single Pokémon.

name: Zinc
effect: Raises Special Defense and happiness.
flavor: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. When consumed, it raises the Sp. Def base points of a single Pokémon.

name: Heal Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Caught Pokémon are immediately healed.
flavor: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the HP of a Pokémon caught with it and eliminates any status conditions.

name: Ultra Ball
locations: Old Man at bench (after Pokédex) / Central City
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 2×.
flavor: An ultra-high-performance Poké Ball that provides a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than a Great Ball.

name: Nest Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3.9× for level 1 Pokémon, and drops steadily to 1× at level 30.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes more effective the lower the level of the wild Pokémon.

name: Great Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 1.5×.
flavor: A good, high-performance Poké Ball that provides a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than a standard Poké Ball.

name: Poké Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
flavor: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It’s thrown like a ball at a Pokémon, comfortably encapsulating its target.

name: Dusk Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3.5× at night and in caves.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places such as caves.

name: Net Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3× for water and bug Pokémon.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective when attempting to catch Water- or Bug-type Pokémon.

name: Timer Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate increases by 0.1× (Gen V: 0.3×) every turn, to a max of 4×.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes progressively more effective at catching Pokémon the more turns that are taken in battle.

name: Dive Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3.5× when underwater, fishing, or surfing.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well when catching Pokémon that live underwater.

name: Repeat Ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3× for previously-caught Pokémon.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on a Pokémon species that has been caught before.

name: Love Ball
effect: 8× effectiveness on opposite sex, same species targets of the Active Pokémon. Made from Pnk Apricorn.
flavor: A Poké Ball that works best when catching a Pokémon that is of the opposite gender of your Pokémon.

name: Bulk Up
effect: Raises the user’s Attack and Defense by one stage.

name: Light Screen
effect: Reduces damage from special attacks by 50% for five turns.

name: Reflect
effect: Reduces damage from physical attacks by half.

name: Double Team
effect: Raises the user’s evasion by one stage.

name: Endure
effect: Prevents the user’s HP from lowering below 1 this turn.

name: Bullet Seed
effect: Hits 2-5 times in one turn.

name: Rock Polish
locations: Scientist at Inhore University / Inhore City
effect: Raises the user’s Speed by two stages.

name: Natural Gift
effect: Power and type depend on the held berry.

name: Attract
effect: Target falls in love if it has the opposite gender, and has a 50% chance to refuse attacking the user.

name: Embargo
effect: Target cannot use held items.

name: Rain Dance
effect: Changes the weather to rain for five turns.

name: Aerial Ace
locations: Boy in Shorts House / Bramboach Town
effect: Never misses.

name: Facade
effect: Power doubles if user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.

name: Hail
effect: Changes the weather to a hailstorm for five turns.

name: Grass Knot
effect: Inflicts more damage to heavier targets, with a maximum of 120 power.

name: X-Scissor
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Shadow Claw
locations: Darkdusk Woods near the Poison Lake
effect: Has an increased chance for a critical hit.

name: Flamethrower
effect: Has a chance to burn the target.

name: Rock Tomb
locations: Hiker near cave exit / Mt. Shuem
effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Speed by one stage.

name: Sandstorm
effect: Changes the weather to a sandstorm for five turns.

name: Roar
effect: Immediately ends wild battles.  Forces trainers to switch Pokémon.

name: Flash
effect: Lowers the target’s accuracy by one stage.

name: Rock Slide
effect: Has a chance to make the target flinch.

name: Secret Power
effect: Has a chance to inflict a status effect which depends upon the terrain.

name: Rock Smash
locations: Prof. Juniper at Inhore University / Inhore City
effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Defense by one stage.

name: Cut
locations: Girl on Apartment 3rd floor / Esmerald City (catch her Shroomish in Foongus Swamp)
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Surf
effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dive users.

name: Fly
locations: Gromet City Gym Leader at the Museum after defeating him / Gromet City
effect: User flies high into the air, dodging all attacks, and hits next turn.

name: Strength
locations: Prof. Juniper / Kenta / Champion depending on your end-game choice — Your House, Yellow Town
effect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

name: Mass Spring Cave / Route 404 — Berry Tree
X Attack
effect: Raises Attack by one stage in battle.  Raises happiness.
flavor: An item that sharply boosts the Attack stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Speed
effect: Raises Speed by one stage in battle.  Raises happiness.
flavor: An item that sharply boosts the Speed stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: X Defend
effect: Raises Defense by one stage in battle.  Raises happiness.
flavor: An item that sharply boosts the Defense stat of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: Poké Doll
locations: Mt. Ice Storm via Waterfall Route
effect: Ends a wild battle.
flavor: A doll that attracts the attention of a Pokémon. It guarantees escape from any battle with wild Pokémon.

name: X Accuracy
effect: Raises accuracy by one stage in battle.  Raises happiness.
flavor: An item that sharply boosts the accuracy of a Pokémon during a battle. It wears off once the Pokémon is withdrawn.

name: Guard Spec.
effect: Prevents stat changes in battle for five turns in battle.  Raises happiness.
flavor: An item that prevents stat reduction among the Trainer’s party Pokémon for five turns after it is used in battle.

name: Bicycle
effect: Use for fast transit.
flavor: A folding Bicycle that enables a rider to get around much faster than a pair of Running Shoes will allow.

name: Griseous Stone
note: Renamed in this hack — PokeAPI lists the vanilla Orb, which is a different item.
gameText: A stone disc with strange engravings depicting two opposing worlds. It feels rough to the touch.

name: Level A Pass
locations: Prof. Oak at the TV Station / Central City
gameText: Basic access pass to the PokéBall Corp. facilities. Given by Professor Oak.

name: Coin Case
effect: Holds coins for the Game Corner.
flavor: A case for holding coins obtained at the Game Corner. It can hold up to 50,000 coins.

name: Dex Radar
locations: Prof. Birch on getting the 1st Badge / Inhore City
gameText: A device that scans the surrounding area and shows which Pokémon can be found nearby.

name: Old Rod
effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
flavor: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: Good Rod
effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
flavor: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: Dungeon Key
locations: One of Ash's pots in Shadow Tower / Darkdusk City
gameText: A very old key that opens the door to some hidden place. It has a bit of rust.

name: Mining Kit
gameText: A kit containing the basic tools for exploring the Mines of Groment City.

name: Lustrous Stone
note: Renamed in this hack — PokeAPI lists the vanilla Orb, which is a different item.
gameText: A stone disc with engravings depicting the states of matter. It shows iridescence when reflecting light.

name: Bright Powder
effect: Held: Increases the holder’s evasion by 1/9 (11 1/9%).
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It casts a tricky glare that lowers the opposing Pokémon’s accuracy.

name: Everstone
effect: Held: Prevents level-based evolution from occuring.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A Pokémon holding this peculiar stone is prevented from evolving.

name: Heart Scale
effect: No effect. Can be traded for prior Level-up moves.
flavor: A pretty, heart-shaped scale that is extremely rare. Some people are happy to receive one.

name: Lax Incense
effect: Held: Holder’s evasion is increased by 5%. Breeding: Wobbuffet begets a Wynaut Egg.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The beguiling aroma of this incense may cause attacks to miss its holder.

name: Life Orb
effect: Held: Holder’s moves inflict 30% extra damage, but cost 10% max HP.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves but at the cost of some HP on each hit.

name: Magmarizer
effect: Traded on a Magmar: Holder evolves into Magmortar.
flavor: A box packed with a tremendous amount of magma energy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

name: Master Ball
effect: Catches a wild Pokémon every time.
flavor: The best Poké Ball with the ultimate level of performance. With it, you will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

name: Gracidea
effect: Changes an unfrozen Shaymin to Sky Forme in the day.
flavor: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions, such as birthdays.

name: Earthquake
effect: Inflicts regular damage and can hit Dig users.

name: Shadow Ball
effect: Has a chance to lower the target’s Special Defense by one stage.

name: Gyro Ball
effect: Power raises when the user has lower Speed, up to a maximum of 150.

name: Rare Candy
locations: Marfeney Lake (Surf), Route 409 (Surf), Gromet Mine, Mt. Ice Storm, Route 403 (Cut)
effect: Causes a level-up and raises happiness.
flavor: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will instantly raise the level of a single Pokémon by one.

name: Sail Fossil
effect: Can be revived into an Amaura.
flavor: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It looks like the impression from a skin sail.
note: One or the other — not both.

name: Jaw Fossil
effect: Can be revived into a Tyrunt.
flavor: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It looks as if it could be a piece of a large jaw.
note: One or the other — not both.

name: Sun Stone
effect: Evolves a Cottonee into Whimsicott, a Gloom into Bellossom, a Petilil into Lilligant, or a Sunkern into Sunflora.
flavor: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It burns as red as the evening sun.
note: Recorded from a capture — this item is not in the seed data.

name: Ice Stone
locations: Mt. Ice Storm — the Feebas fishing room
effect: Evolves an Alola Sandshrew into Alola Sandslash or an Alola Vulpix into Alola Ninetales.
flavor: A peculiar stone that can make certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has an unmistakable snowflake pattern.

name: Old Sea Map
note: Take it to Desire Island for the Jirachi Mystery Gift — save first.
gameText: A faded sea chart that shows the way to a secret island.

name: Pal Pad
note: Used for trading — the GTS building in Central City and the self-trade room in Dardusk Cave.
gameText: A convenient notepad that is used for registering your friends, Friend Codes, and keeping a record of game play.

name: Adaman Stone
note: Hack-exclusive stone, paired with the Griseous and Lustrous Stones.
gameText: A stone disc with engravings depicting the passage of time. It produces a metallic echo when struck.

name: Big Mushroom
effect: Sell for 2500 Pokédollars.
flavor: A rare mushroom that would sell at a high price to shops.

name: Tiny Mushroom
effect: Sell for 250 Pokédollars.
flavor: A small and rare mushroom. It is sought after by collectors.

name: Sticky Barb
effect: Held: the holder loses 1/8 of its max HP at the end of each turn. A Pokémon that makes contact with the holder picks up the Sticky Barb.
flavor: A held item that damages the holder every turn. It may latch on to a Pokémon that touches the holder.

name: Honey
effect: Slather it on a Honey Tree and come back later to find a wild Pokémon on it.
flavor: A sweet honey with a lush aroma that attracts wild Pokémon.

name: Metal Coat
effect: Held: Steel-type moves gain 20% power. Traded on an Onix: holder evolves into Steelix. Traded on a Scyther: holder evolves into Scizor.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a special metallic film that ups the power of Steel-type moves.

name: Oval Stone
effect: Held by a Happiny that levels up during the day: it evolves into Chansey.
flavor: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as round as a Pokémon Egg.

name: Amulet Coin
effect: Held: doubles the prize money from a trainer battle if the holder takes part.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles a battle's prize money if the holding Pokémon joins in.

name: Soft Sand
effect: Held: Ground-type moves gain 20% power.
flavor: A loose, silky sand to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of Ground-type moves.

name: Pearl
effect: Sell for 700 Pokédollars.
flavor: A somewhat-small pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold cheaply to shops.

name: Spell Tag
effect: Held: Ghost-type moves gain 20% power.
flavor: A sinister, eerie tag that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.

name: Light Clay
effect: Held: Reflect and Light Screen set by the holder last 8 turns instead of 5.
flavor: A Pokémon held item that extends the duration of barrier moves like Light Screen and Reflect.

name: Mental Herb
effect: Held: snaps the holder out of infatuation and move-binding effects like Taunt and Encore. Works once.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder shakes off move-binding effects to move freely. It can be used only once.

name: Moomoo Milk
effect: Restores 100 HP to one Pokémon.
flavor: A bottle of highly nutritious milk. It restores 100 HP to one Pokémon.

name: Black Sludge
effect: Held: a Poison-type holder recovers 1/16 of its max HP each turn; any other type loses 1/16 instead.
flavor: A held item that gradually restores the HP of Poison-type Pokémon. It damages any other type.

name: Cheri Berry
effect: Held or used: cures paralysis.
flavor: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from paralysis on its own in battle.

name: Chesto Berry
effect: Held or used: wakes the Pokémon from sleep.
flavor: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from sleep on its own in battle.

name: Aspear Berry
effect: Held or used: thaws a frozen Pokémon.
flavor: If held by a Pokémon, it defrosts on its own in battle.

name: Rawst Berry
effect: Held or used: heals a burn.
flavor: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from a burn on its own in battle.

name: Persim Berry
effect: Held: snaps the holder out of confusion.
flavor: If held by a Pokémon, it recovers from confusion on its own in battle.

name: Oran Berry
effect: Held: restores 10 HP when the holder falls below half HP.
flavor: A Berry to be consumed by Pokémon. If a Pokémon holds one, it can restore its own HP by 10 points during battle.

name: Leppa Berry
effect: Held or used: restores 10 PP to a move that has run out.
flavor: If held by a Pokémon, it restores a move's PP by 10.

name: Haban Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Dragon-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Dragon-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

name: Charti Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Rock-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Rock-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

name: Shuca Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Ground-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Ground-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

name: Yache Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Ice-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Ice-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

name: Rindo Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Grass-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Grass-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

name: Kasib Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Ghost-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Ghost-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

name: Wacan Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Electric-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Electric-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

name: Babiri Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Steel-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Steel-type attack against the holding Pokémon.

name: Colbur Berry
effect: Held: halves the damage of one super-effective Dark-type move.
flavor: Weakens a supereffective Dark-type attack against the holding Pokémon.
